settings.heading: No shoulder padding. No canvas. No lining.
settings.body:
The blazer is unstructured, which means it moves with the body rather than imposing shape upon it. Exposed seams, bound by hand. No padding at the shoulder, no interfacing at the chest, no lining — just the cloth and the construction.

Each blazer takes 6–8 hours to make. The buttonholes are hand-stitched. The lapel is rolled, not pressed. The result is a garment that looks better in ten years than it does on the first day.

settings.heading: A free 30-minute consultation.
settings.body: Talk to one of our advisors about fabric, fit, or anything you want to know. No commitment, no upsell.
